repair_rationale: The repaired lesson itself passed independent review, but the medium conductor initially refused FINISH because it incorrectly treated directly passing controlled gates as incomplete without TRAIN_MORE. The replacement prompt decomposes adaptive decisions: deterministic broker counts and predicate booleans are controller facts, direct pass is at least 6 of 8, TRAIN_MORE is licensed only below 6 of 8, and FINISH never requires remediation for a directly passing gate. It also makes simultaneous bound-visual accounting explicit. This is a same-effort interface and task-granularity repair; lesson bytes, pixels, scenario, learner profile, thresholds, and all pedagogical material remain unchanged.
